title: 37C3 -  Breaking "DRM" in Polish trains
summary: A 37C3 talk on how a series of Polish electric trains stopped working after servicing by an independent company. The speakers explain how train control systems work and how they reverse-engineered the software lockouts.
why: HN cites it as the key account of train DRM being broken, in threads on right to repair, reverse engineering and vendor lockouts.
